name: My Future
overview: Scripture teaches that a believer's future is secure and prosperous when rooted in trust and commitment to the Lord. Like a tree planted by streams of water, one who trusts God will bear fruit in due season and prosper in all they do (Psalms 1:3). The believer is encouraged to commit their way to the Lord and trust Him fully, not relying on their own understanding, confident that God will bring His plans to pass (Psalms 37:5; Proverbs 3:5). This assurance is accompanied by the promise of God's goodness and mercy throughout life and the hope of dwelling in His presence forever (Psalms 23:6).
